summary: The prior position (only GEO headline DEG counts) no longer holds: the publisher supplement host serves Supplementary Table S1, the gene members of nine GO categories enriched among author DESeq2 P<0.05 HP-versus-LP upregulated DEGs (39 genes, direction only). Against the registered edgeR-QL output, 38/39 pair (97.44%) and 38/38 agree in direction (34 local nominal P<0.05, 0 FDR<0.05); Pearson/Spearman are not computable. This meets the v2 direction route within a declared, biased selected scope (about 10% of author up-DEGs, no down genes). No full author table exists in GEO or the supplement. No additionalComparisonSpec is proposed: the AdditionalSpec builder requires a numeric author effect and S1 has none.

manualReview.summary: Author S1 up-regulated chaperone genes agree in direction; no author effects or full table
manualReview.note: The official count/FPKM deposit is accessible, supports the registered maternal low-fat to maternal HFHS comparison, and the local file was rehashed (SHA-256 c41eaa64...). GEO reports the authors' DESeq2 headline of 789 nominal P<0.05 genes (408 up, 381 down), while local edgeR-QL has 1,094 nominal P<0.05 genes (547/547) but only five FDR<0.05. 2026-11-16: publisher Supplementary Table S1 (mmc1.xlsx, SHA-256 cc23c758...) gives the member genes of nine GO categories enriched among HP-versus-LP upregulated DEGs: 39 unique genes, direction only, no per-gene effects, P or FDR. 38 pair by exact symbol with the registered output (97.44%); 38/38 are positive locally (34 nominal P<0.05, none FDR<0.05); Fkbp6 is absent from the registered output. Pearson/Spearman are not computable on a direction-only reference. The selection is author-significant, upregulated and chaperone/UPR-biased from the same six libraries, so sign agreement is expected and does not establish genome-wide agreement. Supplementary Table S2 covers the unregistered 4-PBA contrast. Evidence and script: continued-sources/GSE162744/turbo-2026-11-16-wave2/.

Pearson and Spearman are not computable because the reference is direction only. Locally 34/38 have nominal P<0.05 and 0/38 FDR<0.05. Fkbp6 is absent from the registered output. The scope is about 10% of the 408 author up-DEGs, none of the 381 down-DEGs, and is chaperone/UPR-biased; author inference is not assessed. No full author DESeq2 table is deposited in GEO or the supplement. Evidence: continued-sources/GSE162744/turbo-2026-11-16-wave2/.
verificationReview.nextStep: Keep the 39-gene direction-only scope explicit. Full-universe or effect-level concordance needs the authors' complete HP-versus-LP DESeq2 table (gene IDs, log2FC, P, padj), which is not deposited; request it from the corresponding author.

cohort.note: GEO sample titles assign the same six libraries (LP: Lg42_P1, Lg63_P2, Lg63_P3; HP: Hg43_P1, Hg43_P2, Hg13_P3) to both analyses; the 4-PBA arm is excluded on both sides. Litter independence remains an internal-QC question.

contrast.note: S1 is titled upregulated in HP compared with LP, the same maternal HFHS-minus-low-fat question and orientation as the registered contrast.

features.note: Exact symbol join; 39 unique author symbols, none duplicated; 38 pair and Fkbp6 is absent from the registered output.

effects.note: Author direction only (all up); 38/38 nonzero local logFC are positive (median 0.21). No author magnitudes, so correlation is not computable.

inference.note: Per-gene author P/FDR are not published; 34/38 have local nominal P<0.05 and none FDR<0.05, context only.

coverage.note: 38 of 39 selected genes (97.44%) pair; the scope is about 10% of 408 author up-DEGs and none of 381 down-DEGs.

comparabilityReview.criteria: author-concordance-v2 direction route within the declared selected scope: at least 30 nonzero pairs covering 90% of pairs and 90% reference coverage, with 90% same-gene direction agreement. Correlations are unavailable, not failed. No full-result acceptance is established.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: Direction agrees for every paired author-listed upregulated chaperone/UPR gene; this is selected-gene support, not effect, inference or genome-wide verification.
